data.action: 手持透明雨伞微微向身侧倾斜，清亮蓝眸凝视镜头
data.camera: medium two-shot, clear umbrella tilted toward a companion on a rainy train platform
data.description: 【艾莉 · 雨后车站·共撑一把伞】放学后的车站前飘着淅淅沥沥的细雨，艾莉撑开一把透明雨伞，将伞面不动声色地大半倾斜到你的头顶。她仰起清澈蔚蓝的眼眸，耳根微红地别开视线——「看在你没带伞的份上才顺路捎你一段。靠近一点，肩膀要是淋湿了我可不管。」
data.lighting: cool overcast rainy lighting, wet pavement reflections
data.promptProse: She stands shoulder to shoulder with her companion and tilts the clear umbrella farther over them, leaving her own shoulder near its edge. Cool light catches raindrops on the canopy and their reflections on the wet platform.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 雨后车站·共撑一把伞
data.animaCaption: She tilts the umbrella toward her companion, leaving her own shoulder close to its edge.
